error.portUnconfigured: port is not configured for this Spark
error.primaryPort: Cannot remove the primary LLM port
error.lastPort: Cannot remove the last LLM port
error.workerApi: Worker nodes do not expose a local LLM API
error.llmDisabled: LLM monitoring is disabled for this Spark
error.comfyDisabled: ComfyUI monitoring is disabled for this Spark
error.jobNotFound: Job not found (it may have been replaced by a newer one)

thermal.titleCritical: GPU is close to its shutdown temperature
thermal.hint: Check airflow and the room temperature, and that nothing blocks the vents. Lower the power limit or the load if it keeps climbing.

lowPower.title: GPU has high utilisation with low power draw
lowPower.hint: This can be normal during memory-bound decode. Check workload progress and token throughput first; if progress has stopped, inspect driver logs and power-management settings.
lowPower.detail: {{util}}% utilisation but only {{power}} W for {{samples}} samples in a row.

memory.hint: The kernel may start killing processes. Stop a model you are not using, lower the context length or the GPU memory utilisation.

xid.title: NVIDIA Xid error
xid.hint: Look up the Xid code in NVIDIA's Xid catalog. Repeated driver-class Xids point at hardware or a driver bug.
xid.detail: A GPU or driver error was logged by the kernel within the last hour ({{count}} since boot).

oom.title: Kernel killed a process (out of memory)
oom.hint: Something ran out of memory. Lower the model's memory use or stop other workloads.
oom.detail: The kernel's OOM killer ended a process within the last hour ({{count}} since boot).

concurrency.title: Several models are loaded on this node
concurrency.hint: Heavy backends compete for the same unified memory. Stop the ones you are not using to avoid out-of-memory kills.
concurrency.detail: {{count}} different models are serving while {{percent}}% of memory is in use.

linkSpeed.title: Network link is slower than 1 Gb/s
linkSpeed.hint: Check the cable and the switch port. A cluster running over a degraded link slows every tensor-parallel step.

roceLink.hint: Check the cable, the transceiver and the switch port. Tensor-parallel and NCCL traffic over this port stalls or falls back to another path.

roceLoss.title: RoCE is dropping packets
roceLoss.hint: Rising out_of_buffer, sequence or ack-timeout errors point at congestion or a lossless-network (PFC/ECN) misconfiguration. Compare the PFC and trust settings on every Spark and on the switch.
